scope: Seven S217/S221/S229 Sports / Workout products checked at their full source resolution
boardNote: One identity rejected from catalog · six retained with Sports / Workout-only styling constraints · no complete outfit approval or UI integration

entries.label: Burnt-Coral Vent-Mapped Active Tee
entries.reason: The full source proves a regular athletic body, natural shoulder and breathable tonal mapping rather than compression tightness. Keep the happy coral as S217's color lead with a controlled olive technical trouser, off-white shell and streamlined light trainer; no second loud color, bulky shoe or casual cargo piece.

entries.label: Olive Ankle-Length Technical Trouser
entries.reason: The source shows useful thigh ease, a controlled taper and clean ankle length; it is not a skinny jogger. The black buckle and zip hardware make it strictly technical, so pair only with a clean performance top and low-profile trainer; never add cargo pockets, a bulky layer or formal styling.

entries.label: Off-White Lightweight Technical Shell
entries.reason: The worn source proves a clean regular shoulder, light movement ease and a straight hip-length body without oversized volume. Keep for Spring or Fall Sports, active Travel or technical Casual only, and use it as the light neutral over one controlled color story.

entries.label: Ice-Blue Raglan Performance Tee
entries.reason: The full source has a regular straight body, clean raglan shoulder and subtle tonal ventilation mapping. Keep only for warm-weather Sports / Workout with the mint two-in-one short and a streamlined white-gray trainer; do not turn the pale palette into generic casualwear or add a dark bulky layer.

entries.label: Mint Two-in-One Running Short
entries.reason: The source clearly proves an above-knee running outer short, fitted support liner and controlled athletic volume. It is authentic gymwear, not a casual Resort short; preserve the two-in-one construction and use only for Sports / Workout with a regular performance tee and minimal trainer.

entries.label: Gray-Sage Stand-Collar Half-Zip Active Base
entries.reason: The source proves a regular shoulder and straight movement-friendly body, but the long plain silhouette is a supporting Winter base layer rather than a hero piece. Keep only beneath a short cream technical puffer with a lighter controlled-straight trouser and cream-gray trainer; no dark outer layer, dark bottom or all-muted outfit.

entries.label: Dark-Navy Narrow Stacked Jogger
entries.reason: The full source contradicts the previous clean-leg judgment: the leg narrows continuously below the knee and visibly stacks over both shoes. Its near-black navy and generic drawstring finish recreate the dark skinny-jogger problem, so it is removed rather than rescued with lighter companions.
